स—शैल-वन-कानन mfn. having mountains and woods and groves, MBh.
स—शीर्षन् (स-), mfn. having a head (opp. to अप-श्˚), TS.; TBr.
स—शीत्कार mfn. uttering a murmuring sound, Vikr.
स—शीत्कारम् (अम्), ind. with a m˚ s˚, MW.
with a sigh, ib.

m: स—शूक mf(आ)n. furnished with awns, ĀpŚr.
स—शूक m. a believer in the existence of God (= आस्तिक), L.
स—शूलम् ind. with sharp pain (as of colic or gout), Suśr.
स—शङ्ख mfn. having a conch-shell, MW.
स—शङ्ख—गोष mfn. resounding with conch-shells, ib.
स—शङ्क mf(आ)n. fearful, doubtful, timid, shy (अम् ind.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
suspicious, Kathās.
स—शङ्कम् ind.
स—शब्द mf(आ)n. having sound or noise, full of cries, sounding, Kāv.; Kathās.; Rājat.
proclaimed, MW.
a: सशब्द — a. 1 Sounding. --2 Proclaimed. --ब्दं ind. With a loud noise; भग्नं सशब्दं शिरः Bk. 2. 90.

m: स—शब्दम् (अम्), ind. with noise, noisily, Gobh.; MBh. &c.
स-शकल mfn. (i.e. 7. स + श्˚) having scales, together with scales, IndSt.
स—शल्क mfn. having bark or rind or scales, Gaut.
स—शल्य mf(आ)n. pierced by an arrow or dart, stung, wounded (also fig. = ‘pained, afflicted’), R.; Kālid.; Kathās.
thorny, connected with pain or sorrow, troublesome, difficult, HPariś.
स—शल्य m. a bear, L.
a: सशल्य — a. 1 Thorny. --2 Pierced by darts or thorns. --3 Troublesome, difficult.

m: स—शपथम् ind. with an oath, Mṛcch.
स—श˚रासन mfn. with a bow, VarYogay.
स—शरीर (स-), mf(आ)n. with the body, embodied, TBr.; PañcavBr.; R.
with the bones, KātyŚr.
स—शर mfn. furnished with an arrow, together with an arrow, R.; Kālid.
स—शर—चाप-हस्त mfn. holding a bow with an arrow in the hand, Ml.
स—श˚रिन् mfn. furnished with an arrow, MBh.
स—शर्कर mf(आ)n. together with gravel or sand, VarBṛS.
with brown sugar, Suśr.
1. स—शस्त्र mf(आ)n. having or containing an invocation (see p. 1044, col. 1), MārkP.
2. स—शस्त्र mfn. having arms, armed, Veṇīs.

m: स—शस्या (आ), f. Tiaridium Indicum, L.
स—शस्य mfn. w.r. for -सस्य, Hariv.
a: सशस्य — a. Having or yielding corn. --स्या A variety of sun-flower.

m: स—शत्रु mfn. having enemies, MBh.
स—शयन mf(ई)n. lying or standing together, contiguous, neighbouring, ṢaḍvBr.; Lāṭy.
सश्च् (only सोश्चत्). See √ सच्.
a: सश्च् — {c1c} U. (सश्चति-ते) Ved. 1 To cling or stick to, follow. --2 To serve, worship, honour. --3 To pervade; see सच्.

m: सश्चत् m. a pursuer, enemy, RV.
स—शे˚षान्न mfn. one who eats up the remnants of food (= ‘having a good appetite’), Suśr.
स—शेष mfn. having a remainder, not entirely emptied or exhausted, incomplete, unfinished, KātyŚr.
स—शेष—त्व n. the having a remainder (-त्वाद् आयुषः, ‘because life had not yet run out’), MBh.
स—शृङ्गार mfn. having ornaments, adorned, decorated, Pañcat.; Kathās.
स—शृङ्गा˚रकम् ind. with love, passionately, tenderly, Mṛcch.
स—शिखण्डिन् mfn. accompanied by Śikhaṇḍin, MBh.
स—शिखर mfn. having a top (as a tree), R.
स—शिबिर mfn. together with (his) camp, Śṛṅgār.
स—शि˚रावमज्जन n. (fr. शिर = शिरस् + अव्˚) diving with the head foremost, ĀpŚr., Sch.
स—शि˚रः-कम्पम् ind. shaking the head, Mṛcch.
स—शिरस् mfn. along with the head, Āpast.
स—शि˚रस्क mfn. (= -शिरस्), Gobh.
स—शिष्य mfn. attended by pupils, Śak.
स—श्लाघम् ind. boastfully, pompously, Vikr.; Prab.
with praise, eulogistically, MW.
स—श्लेष mfn. ambiguous, having a double meaning (-त्व n.), Kāvyād.
स—श्लेष—त्व n.

m: स—श्मश्रु mfn. having a beard, bearded, L.
स—श्मश्रु f. a woman with a beard, L.
a: सश्मश्रु — a. Bearded. --f. A woman with a beard.

m: स—शोक mf(आ)n. sorrowful, sad (अम् ind.), R.; Kālid. &c.
स—शोकम् (अम्), ind.
स—शोक—ता f. sorrow, sadness, MBh.
स—श्री mfn. like, similar to (comp.), KāśīKh.
स—श्रीक mf(आ)n. having beauty, lovely, splendid (-ता f. -त्व n.), Vikr.; Ratnāv.
having prosperity, prosperous, fortunate, Śiś., Sch.
a: सश्रीक — a. 1 Prosperous, fortunate. --2 Lovely, beautiful.

m: स—श्रीक—ता f.
स—श्रीक—त्व n.
स—श्री-वृक्ष mfn. marked with a circular tuft or curl of hair on the breast (as a horse), Kathās.
स—श्रद्ध mf(आ)n. trustful, frank, confident, Kathās.
स—श्रम mf(आ)n. feeling fatigue, wearied, W.
स—शुच् mfn. grieved, afflicted, Amar.
स—शुक्र (स-), mfn. together with brightness or with what is bright (-त्व n.), TS.; ŚBr.
स—शुक्र—त्व n.
स—श्वास mfn. having breath, breathing, living, Rājat.
सश्यान w.r. for सं-शान, GopBr.
स—श्यापर्ण mfn. attended by the Śyāparṇas, AitBr.
